menu_options.credentials: Sign in with email and password

token.title: Access token
token.description: Paste a Bearer token for your EP Cube account. Pick the region your account belongs to. An account exists on exactly one, and a token from the wrong one fails as though it had expired.

credentials.title: Sign in
credentials.description: The same email and password you use in the EP Cube app. Signing in solves a puzzle CAPTCHA, which occasionally needs a second attempt.

reauth_confirm.title: Access token expired
reauth_confirm.description: The token for your {region} account is no longer accepted. Paste a new one.

error.invalid_auth: Token rejected. It may have expired, or it may belong to a different region. Check the region before replacing it.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EP Cube service.
error.captcha_failed: Could not complete sign-in. The puzzle CAPTCHA fails intermittently; try again.
error.no_device: That account has no system attached to it.

abort.already_configured: This system is already set up.

data.enable_statistics: Read monthly, yearly and lifetime totals

data_description.enable_series: The only source of a measured battery power reading. Without it, battery power is inferred from the other flows and carries some noise.
data_description.enable_statistics: Four extra requests per update. These totals change slowly, so leaving this off costs little.

token_expired.message: The EP Cube access token is no longer valid.

config_unavailable.message: The current device configuration could not be read, so it cannot be changed safely.

no_tou_schedule.message: No time-of-use periods are configured. Switching to that mode now would leave the battery on an empty tariff calendar.

soc_unknown.message: The battery level is not known yet, so the current level cannot be held.

target_soc_required.message: A target battery level is required.

device_not_loaded.message: The EP Cube system for device {device_id} is not loaded.

bad_tou_window.message: {window} in {field} is not a valid time-of-use window. Use HH:MM_HH:MM_price, or a mapping with start, end and price.

grid_charging_rejected.message: The device did not accept the change to grid charging. On some units this setting is read-only, locked by the installer or by grid-connection rules.

set_tou_schedule.name: Set time-of-use schedule
set_tou_schedule.description: Writes the tariff calendar. Lists left out keep their current value; pass an empty list to clear one.

peak.name: Peak windows
peak.description: Windows charged at the peak rate.

off_peak.name: Off-peak windows
off_peak.description: Windows at the cheapest rate, when the battery prefers to charge.

peak_non_workday.name: Peak windows (non-workdays)
peak_non_workday.description: Peak windows for weekends and holidays.

mid_peak_non_workday.name: Mid-peak windows (non-workdays)
mid_peak_non_workday.description: Mid-peak windows for weekends and holidays.

off_peak_non_workday.name: Off-peak windows (non-workdays)
off_peak_non_workday.description: Off-peak windows for weekends and holidays.

apply.name: Switch to Time of Use
apply.description: Also put the device into Time-of-Use mode. Off by default, so the calendar is saved without changing how the battery is running.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EP Cube system to act on.

set_operating_mode.name: Set operating mode
set_operating_mode.description: Changes the operating mode, optionally setting that mode's reserve too.

reserve_soc.name: Reserve level
reserve_soc.description: Battery level to hold in reserve. Applies to the mode being selected: the backup reserve for Backup, otherwise the self-consumption reserve.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EP Cube system to act on.

force_charge.name: Force charge
force_charge.description: Charges the battery to a target level by raising the reserve. The previous reserve is restored when the duration elapses.

target_soc.name: Target level
target_soc.description: Charge until the battery reaches this level.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold the override. Left empty it runs until cleared, which is worth avoiding: nothing will put the settings back.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EP Cube system to act on.

force_discharge.name: Force discharge
force_discharge.description: Lets the battery supply the house down to a target level by lowering the reserve. The previous reserve is restored afterwards.

target_soc.name: Target level
target_soc.description: Discharge no further than this level.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold the override.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EP Cube system to act on.

hold_battery.name: Hold battery
hold_battery.description: Freezes the battery at its current level by setting the reserve to match it, so it will not discharge below where it is now.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EP Cube system to act on.

clear_override.name: Clear override
clear_override.description: Ends any override now and restores the settings from before it.

device_id.description: The EP Cube system to act on.
